description: StrongCrypt V1 canonical test vectors for envelope format validation and cross-implementation compatibility. All byte arrays are hex-encoded.

vectors.name: minimal_empty
vectors.description: Minimal valid envelope: empty plaintext, no KeyId, no external AAD
vectors.notes: All-zero key and nonce for deterministic test. Protocol header [0,22) is authenticated as AAD.

vectors.name: simple_plaintext_no_keyid
vectors.description: Short plaintext, no KeyId, no external AAD
vectors.notes: Plaintext 'Hello World!' (12 bytes). Tag placeholder 'xx...' represents actual GCM output (implementation-dependent without fixed nonce).

vectors.name: with_keyid
vectors.description: Plaintext with 8-byte KeyId, no external AAD
vectors.notes: KeyId='key-id1234' (8 bytes). Plaintext 'SecretData!' (10 bytes). Protocol header [0,30) authenticated.

vectors.name: with_external_aad
vectors.description: Plaintext with external AAD, no KeyId
vectors.notes: Plaintext 'Data' (4 bytes). External AAD 'context-string' (14 bytes) is authenticated but not in envelope. AuthenticatedData = ProtocolHeader[0,22) || ExternalAAD.

vectors.name: max_keyid_length
vectors.notes: KeyId is 64 repetitions of 'k'. Plaintext 'Test!' (5 bytes). Protocol header [0,86) authenticated.

vectors.name: empty_plaintext_with_metadata
vectors.description: Empty plaintext with KeyId and external AAD
vectors.notes: KeyId='myKey' (5 bytes). Empty plaintext. External AAD='myAAD' (5 bytes). Tests zero-length ciphertext with metadata.

hostile_inputs.name: unsupported_profile
hostile_inputs.reason: Profile 0x02 not supported (V1 only accepts 0x01 for AES-256-GCM)

hostile_inputs.name: reserved_flags_set
hostile_inputs.reason: Flags field has bit set (must be 0x00 in V1)

hostile_inputs.name: ciphertext_length_overflow
hostile_inputs.reason: CiphertextLen field would overflow int.MaxValue or cause invalid total size

hostile_inputs.name: trailing_bytes
hostile_inputs.reason: Envelope has trailing byte after tag (V1 disallows)

hostile_inputs.name: truncated_at_tag
hostile_inputs.reason: Envelope claims size but tag incomplete

hostile_inputs.name: authentication_failure_modified_tag
hostile_inputs.reason: Valid structure but tag modified (last byte changed to 0x01 instead of correct tag)

implementation_notes.tagPlaceholder: Vectors with 'xx...' in envelope field require implementation to compute actual GCM tag. These are template vectors for structure validation, not bit-exact KATs.
implementation_notes.deterministicVector: The 'minimal_empty' vector uses all-zero key/nonce for deterministic tag computation and can serve as a known-answer test.
implementation_notes.aadFraming: External AAD is NOT part of the envelope bytes. It is concatenated with the protocol header during AEAD operation: AuthenticatedData = ProtocolHeader || ExternalAAD.
implementation_notes.byteOrder: All multi-byte integers are little-endian. Magic=0x5343 is bytes [0x43, 0x53]. CiphertextLen is u32 little-endian at offset 18+KeyIdLen.
implementation_notes.testStrategy: Implementations should: (1) parse and validate structure for all vectors; (2) verify envelope size calculations; (3) confirm hostile inputs rejected with correct error type; (4) round-trip encryption/decryption with these parameters.
